        "contents": "\n\nexport const Floating = ( {\n  children,\n  className,\n  sensitivity = 1,\n  easingFactor = 0.05,\n  ...props\n}: FloatingProps ) =\u003e {\n  const containerRef = useRef\u003cHTMLDivElement\u003e( null )\n  const elementsMap = useRef(\n    new Map\u003c\n      string,\n      {\n        element: HTMLDivElement\n        depth: number\n        currentPosition: { x: number; y: number }\n      }\n    \u003e()\n  )\n  const mousePositionRef = useFloatingMousePosition( containerRef )\n\n  const registerElement = useCallback(\n    ( id: string, element: HTMLDivElement, depth: number ) =\u003e {\n      elementsMap.current.set( id, {\n        element,\n        depth,\n        currentPosition: { x: 0, y: 0 },\n      } )\n    },\n    []\n  )\n\n  const unregisterElement = useCallback( ( id: string ) =\u003e {\n    elementsMap.current.delete( id )\n  }, [] )\n\n  useAnimationFrame( () =\u003e {\n    if ( !containerRef.current ) return\n\n    elementsMap.current.forEach( ( data ) =\u003e {\n      const strength = ( data.depth * sensitivity ) / 20\n\n      // Calculate new target position\n      const newTargetX = mousePositionRef.current.x * strength\n      const newTargetY = mousePositionRef.current.y * strength\n\n      // Check if we need to update\n      const dx = newTargetX - data.currentPosition.x\n      const dy = newTargetY - data.currentPosition.y\n\n      // Update position only if we're still moving\n      data.currentPosition.x += dx * easingFactor\n      data.currentPosition.y += dy * easingFactor\n\n      data.element.style.transform = &#96;translate3d(${data.currentPosition.x}px, ${data.currentPosition.y}px, 0)&#96;\n    } )\n  } )\n\n  return (\n    \u003cFloatingContext.Provider value={{ registerElement, unregisterElement }}\u003e\n      \u003cdiv\n        ref={containerRef}\n        className={cn( \"absolute top-0 left-0 w-full h-full\", className )}\n        {...props}\n      \u003e\n        {children}\n      \u003c/div\u003e\n    \u003c/FloatingContext.Provider\u003e\n  )\n}",

        "contents": "\n\nfunction useDropdownMenu({\n  initialOpen = false,\n  open: controlledOpen,\n  onOpenChange: setControlledOpen,\n  side = \"bottom\",\n  align = \"start\",\n}: DropdownMenuOptions) {\n  const [uncontrolledOpen, setUncontrolledOpen] = React.useState(initialOpen)\n  const [currentPlacement, setCurrentPlacement] = React.useState\u003cPlacement\u003e(\n    &#96;${side}-${align}&#96; as Placement\n  )\n  const [activeIndex, setActiveIndex] = React.useState\u003cnumber | null\u003e(null)\n\n  const open = controlledOpen ?? uncontrolledOpen\n  const setOpen = setControlledOpen ?? setUncontrolledOpen\n\n  const elementsRef = React.useRef\u003cArray\u003cHTMLElement | null\u003e\u003e([])\n  const labelsRef = React.useRef\u003cArray\u003cstring | null\u003e\u003e([])\n\n  const floating = useFloating({\n    open,\n    onOpenChange: setOpen,\n    placement: currentPlacement,\n    middleware: [offset({ mainAxis: 4 }), flip(), shift({ padding: 4 })],\n    whileElementsMounted: autoUpdate,\n  })\n\n  const { context } = floating\n\n  const interactions = useInteractions([\n    useClick(context, {\n      event: \"mousedown\",\n      toggle: true,\n      ignoreMouse: false,\n    }),\n    useRole(context, { role: \"menu\" }),\n    useDismiss(context, {\n      outsidePress: true,\n      outsidePressEvent: \"mousedown\",\n    }),\n    useListNavigation(context, {\n      listRef: elementsRef,\n      activeIndex,\n      onNavigate: setActiveIndex,\n      loop: true,\n    }),\n    useTypeahead(context, {\n      listRef: labelsRef,\n      onMatch: open ? setActiveIndex : undefined,\n      activeIndex,\n    }),\n  ])\n\n  const updatePosition = React.useCallback(\n    (\n      newSide: \"top\" | \"right\" | \"bottom\" | \"left\",\n      newAlign: \"start\" | \"center\" | \"end\"\n    ) =\u003e {\n      setCurrentPlacement(&#96;${newSide}-${newAlign}&#96; as Placement)\n    },\n    []\n  )",

y: number }\n      }\n    \u003e()\n  )\n  const mousePositionRef = useFloatingMousePosition( containerRef )\n\n  const registerElement = useCallback(\n    ( id: string, element: HTMLDivElement, depth: number ) =\u003e {\n      elementsMap.current.set( id, {\n        element,\n        depth,\n        currentPosition: { x: 0, y: 0 },\n      } )\n    },\n    []\n  )\n\n  const unregisterElement = useCallback( ( id: string ) =\u003e {\n    elementsMap.current.delete( id )\n  }, [] )\n\n  useAnimationFrame( () =\u003e {\n    if ( !containerRef.current ) return\n\n    elementsMap.current.forEach( ( data ) =\u003e {\n      const strength = ( data.depth * sensitivity ) / 20\n\n      // Calculate new target position\n      const newTargetX = mousePositionRef.current.x * strength\n      const newTargetY = mousePositionRef.current.y * strength\n\n      // Check if we need to update\n      const dx = newTargetX - data.currentPosition.x\n      const dy = newTargetY - data.currentPosition.y\n\n      // Update position only if we're still moving\n      data.currentPosition.x += dx * easingFactor\n      data.currentPosition.y += dy * easingFactor\n\n      data.element.style.transform = &#96;translate3d(${data.currentPosition.x}px, ${data.currentPosition.y}px, 0)&#96;\n    } )\n  } )\n\n  return (\n    \u003cFloatingContext.Provider value={{ registerElement, unregisterElement }}\u003e\n      \u003cdiv\n        ref={containerRef}\n        className={cn( \"absolute top-0 left-0 w-full h-full\", className )}\n        {...props}\n      \u003e\n        {children}\n      \u003c/div\u003e\n    \u003c/FloatingContext.Provider\u003e\n  )\n}",

        "contents": "export function Graph(props: any) {\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  return (\n    \u003cdiv\n      className='relative h-[100vh] w-[100vw] bg-black bg-repeat z-0'\n      style={{\n        backgroundImage:\n          \"url('data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20width=%2220%22%20height=%2220%22%20viewBox=%220%200%2020%2020%22%3E%3Ccircle%20cx=%221%22%20cy=%221%22%20r=%221%22%20fill=%22%23ccc%22%20fill-opacity=%220.3%22/%3E%3C/svg%3E')\",\n      }}\u003e\n      \u003cReactFlow\n        ref={ref}\n        colorMode='dark'\n        nodeTypes={nodeTypes}\n        edgeTypes={edgeTypes}\n        // snapToGrid={true}\n        defaultEdgeOptions={edgeOptions}\n        nodes={nodes}\n        edges={edges}\n        onNodesChange={onNodesChange}\n        onEdgesChange={onEdgesChange}\n        onConnect={onConnect}\n        onNodesDelete={onNodesDelete}\n        // connectionLineComponent={FloatingConnectionLine}\n        elevateNodesOnSelect={true}\n        fitView\n        defaultViewport={{\n          zoom: 0,\n          x: 0,\n          y: 0,\n        }}\n        style={{backgroundColor: 'transparent'}}\u003e\n        \u003cPanel position='center-left'\u003e\n          \u003cdiv className='ml-2 mt-2'\u003e\n            \u003cMindMapSideMenu /\u003e\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n        \u003c/Panel\u003e\n\n        \u003cPanel position='top-right'\u003e\n          {/* \u003cThreadBoard /\u003e */}\n          {/* \u003cCaseFilesAndEvidenceBoard /\u003e */}\n          \u003cSessionNotes /\u003e\n        \u003c/Panel\u003e\n\n        \u003cMindMapAnimatedClickMenu\n          isOpen={isOpen}\n          clickPosition={clickPosition}\n          closeMenu={closeMenu}\n        /\u003e\n\n        \u003cPanel position='bottom-center'\u003e\n          \u003cMindMapBottomMenu /\u003e\n        \u003c/Panel\u003e\n\n        {/* bg-gradient-to-r from-black/50 to-transparent  */}\n      \u003c/ReactFlow\u003e\n      \n      {/* Connected Records Panel - Outside ReactFlow */}\n      {nodes.some(node =\u003e node.type \u0026\u0026 node.type !== 'userInputNode' \u0026\u0026 node.data \u0026\u0026 (node.data.name || node.data.title || node.data.label)) \u0026\u0026 \u003cConnectedRecordsPanel /\u003e}\n    \u003c/div\u003e\n  )\n}",

+   onClick,
+   searchQuery 
+ }: {

+     if (!searchQuery) return text
+     const regex = new RegExp(&#96;(${searchQuery})&#96;, 'gi')
+     const parts = text.split(regex)
+     return parts.map((part, i) =&gt; 
+       regex.test(part) ? &lt;span key={i} className="text-cyan-400"&gt;{part}&lt;/span&gt; : part
+     )
+   }

+   return (

+       animate={{

+         height: isActive ? 36 : 0,
+       }}

+       )}
+       onClick={onClick}
+     &gt;
+       &lt;div className="w-4 h-4 flex items-center justify-center text-white/50"&gt;
+         {command.icon}
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+       &lt;div className="flex-1"&gt;{highlightMatch(command.name)}&lt;/div&gt;
+       {command.description &amp;&amp; (

+       )}

+   )
+ }

- 
+ # Canvas Menu Component
+ 
+ A beautiful, modern floating command palette for the Ultraterrestrial mindmap interface, inspired by CommandK design patterns.
+ 
+ ## Features
+ 
+ - 🎨 **Glassmorphic Design** - Beautiful backdrop blur effects with subtle animations
+ - ⌨️ **Keyboard First** - Full keyboard navigation with Cmd/Ctrl+K shortcut
+ - 🔍 **Smart Search** - Real-time filtering of commands with highlighting
+ - 💬 **AI Integration** - Built-in chat interface with AI assistant
+ - 🎯 **Entity Management** - Quick access to add entities to the mindmap
+ - 🗺️ **Tour Controls** - Guided and free exploration modes
+ - ✨ **Smooth Animations** - Framer Motion powered transitions
+ - 📱 **Responsive** - Works on all screen sizes
+ 
+ ## Usage
+ 
+ ### Basic Usage
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;tsx
+ import { CanvasMenu } from '@/features/mindmap/components/menus/canvas-menu'
+ 
+ function MyComponent() {
+   const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false)
+   
+   const handleAction = (action: MenuAction) =&gt; {
+     console.log('Action triggered:', action)
+     // Handle the action based on type
+     switch (action.type) {
+       case 'chat':
+         // Handle chat action
+         break
+       case 'add-entity':
+         // Handle entity addition
+         break
+       // ... other cases
+     }
+   }
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;CanvasMenu
+       isOpen={isOpen}
+       onClose={() =&gt; setIsOpen(false)}
+       onAction={handleAction}
+     /&gt;
+   )
+ }
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Custom Positioning
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;tsx
+ &lt;CanvasMenu
+   position={{ x: 400, y: 300 }}
+   isOpen={isOpen}
+   onClose={() =&gt; setIsOpen(false)}
+   onAction={handleAction}
+ /&gt;
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### With Custom Trigger
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;tsx
+ &lt;CanvasMenu
+   className="bottom-8 right-8" // Position the trigger button
+   onAction={handleAction}
+ /&gt;
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## Props
+ 
+ | Prop | Type | Default | Description |
+ |------|------|---------|-------------|
+ | &#96;position&#96; | &#96;{ x: number, y: number }&#96; | Center of screen | Position of the menu when open |
+ | &#96;isOpen&#96; | &#96;boolean&#96; | &#96;false&#96; | Controlled open state |
+ | &#96;onClose&#96; | &#96;() =&gt; void&#96; | - | Callback when menu is closed |
+ | &#96;onAction&#96; | &#96;(action: MenuAction) =&gt; void&#96; | - | Callback when action is triggered |
+ | &#96;className&#96; | &#96;string&#96; | - | Additional classes for trigger button |
+ 
+ ## Menu Actions
+ 
+ The &#96;onAction&#96; callback receives a &#96;MenuAction&#96; object with the following structure:
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript
+ interface MenuAction {
+   type: 'search' | 'chat' | 'add-entity' | 'tour' | 'command' | 'model-select'
+   data: any // Action-specific data
+ }
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ### Action Types
+ 
+ - **&#96;chat&#96;** - AI chat interaction
+ - **&#96;search&#96;** - Database search
+ - **&#96;add-entity&#96;** - Add entity to mindmap (topics, events, personnel, etc.)
+ - **&#96;tour&#96;** - Start guided or free exploration
+ - **&#96;command&#96;** - Execute specific commands (grid layout, etc.)
+ - **&#96;model-select&#96;** - Select AI model
+ 
+ ## Keyboard Shortcuts
+ 
+ - **&#96;Cmd/Ctrl + K&#96;** - Open/close the menu
+ - **&#96;Escape&#96;** - Close the menu
+ - **&#96;Enter&#96;** - Select highlighted command or send chat message
+ - **&#96;↑/↓&#96;** - Navigate through commands
+ - **&#96;Type&#96;** - Filter commands in real-time
+ 
+ ## Styling
+ 
+ The component uses Tailwind CSS and can be customized through:
+ 
+ 1. **CSS Variables** - Override color schemes
+ 2. **className prop** - Position and style the trigger button
+ 3. **Tailwind config** - Extend theme for consistent styling
+ 
+ ## Integration with Mindmap
+ 
+ While this component is designed to replace the current &#96;MindMapBottomMenu&#96;, it's built as a standalone component for easy testing and gradual integration.
+ 
+ ### Future Integration Steps
+ 
+ 1. Replace the bottom menu in &#96;Graph.tsx&#96;
+ 2. Connect to existing mindmap context
+ 3. Wire up entity addition and search functions
+ 4. Integrate with tour system
+ 5. Connect AI chat to existing assistant
+ 
+ ## Development
+ 
+ ### Running Storybook
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ npm run storybook
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ Navigate to **Mindmap &gt; Menus &gt; CanvasMenu** to see all stories.
+ 
+ ### Testing
+ 
+ The component includes comprehensive Storybook stories for:
+ - Default state
+ - Open with search
+ - Custom positioning
+ - Interactive playground
+ - Mobile responsive view
+ 
+ ## Architecture
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ canvas-menu/
+ ├── CanvasMenu.tsx          # Main component
+ ├── CanvasMenu.stories.tsx  # Storybook stories
+ ├── index.ts               # Exports
+ └── README.md             # Documentation
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## Dependencies
+ 
+ - &#96;framer-motion&#96; - Animations
+ - &#96;@ai-sdk/react&#96; - AI assistant integration
+ - &#96;lucide-react&#96; - Icons
+ - &#96;tailwindcss&#96; - Styling
+ 
+ ## Future Enhancements
+ 
+ - [ ] Add more keyboard navigation (Tab, arrow keys)
+ - [ ] Implement command history
+ - [ ] Add command shortcuts/aliases
+ - [ ] Support for nested commands
+ - [ ] Theme customization
+ - [ ] Accessibility improvements (ARIA labels, screen reader support)
+ - [ ] Command palette plugins/extensions
+ - [ ] Voice command support
```

Perfect! I've successfully created a beautiful Canvas Menu component that integrates the CommandK UI design with all the functionality from the mindmap bottom menu. Here's what I've built:

## 🎉 What Was Created

### 1. **CanvasMenu Component** (`CanvasMenu.tsx`)
A modern, floating command palette with:
- **Beautiful glassmorphic design** inspired by the CommandK component
- **Floating keyboard key decorations** that animate in
- **Smart search filtering** with real-time highlighting
- **AI chat integration** using the existing `useAssistant` hook
- **Entity management** for all entity types (topics, events, personnel, etc.)
- **Tour controls** for guided and free exploration
- **Keyboard shortcuts** (Cmd/Ctrl + K to open)
- **Smooth Framer Motion animations**

### 2. **Comprehensive Storybook Stories** (`CanvasMenu.stories.tsx`)
- **Default Story**: Shows the floating trigger button
- **Open with Search**: Demonstrates search functionality
- **Custom Position**: Shows positioning flexibility
- **Playground**: Interactive demo with action history
- **Mobile**: Responsive mobile view

### 3. **Documentation** (`README.md`)
Complete documentation including:
- Feature list
- Usage examples
- Props documentation
- Integration guide
- Architecture overview
- Future enhancements

### 4. **Demo Page** (`demo.tsx`)
A standalone demo page for testing with:
- Interactive controls
- Action logging
- Position testing
- Feature showcase

## 🎨 Key Design Features

1. **CommandK-Inspired UI**:
   - Floating keyboard keys with realistic styling
   - Backdrop blur effects
   - Smooth category transitions
   - Search highlighting

2. **Enhanced Functionality**:
   - All features from the original mindmap bottom menu
   - Better organization with categorized commands
   - Integrated AI chat within the command palette
   - Smart positioning system

3. **Beautiful Animations**:
   - Spring animations for smooth transitions
   - Staggered animations for visual hierarchy
   - Hover and active states

## 🚀 How to Use

The component is ready to use but **NOT yet integrated** into the mindmap as requested. To test it:

1. **View in Storybook**:
   ```bash
   npm run storybook
   ```
   Navigate to: **Mindmap > Menus > CanvasMenu**

2. **Use the Component**:
   ```tsx
   import { CanvasMenu } from '@/features/mindmap/components/menus/canvas-menu'
   
   <CanvasMenu
     onAction={(action) => console.log(action)}
   />
   ```

## 🔄 Future Integration

When you're ready to integrate with the mindmap:

1. Import the component in your mindmap view
2. Connect to the existing `useMindMap` context
3. Wire up the action handlers to existing functions
4. Replace or complement the current bottom menu

The component is designed to be a drop-in replacement with all the same functionality but a much more modern and beautiful interface!
